context_requirements: Intact nuclear hormone receptor transcriptional machinery
Sufficient 24 h exposure for secondary transcriptional and antiproliferative effects
Responsive lineage context, especially prostate, breast, colon, and myeloid cells
falsifiers: No consistent induction of canonical VDR target genes such as CYP27B1, SLC20A2, or TSC22D3 at 6 h or 24 h
No antiproliferative or G1-arrest signature at 24 h in VDR-expressing lines
Strong and uniform transcriptional responses across all nine lines, including lines with low VDR expression
Predominant upregulation of proliferation genes rather than downregulation

evidence.supports: VDR agonist elocalcitol inhibits prostate cell proliferation and inflammation and increases apoptosis in vivo
VDR agonist elocalcitol inhibits IL-8-dependent prostate stromal cell proliferation and inflammatory signaling
VDR agonist BXL-628 inhibits RhoA/Rho-kinase signaling in bladder smooth muscle
VDR agonists act through transcriptional regulation of vitamin D target genes and have antiproliferative and pro-differentiating activity
Calcitriol selectively upregulates SLC20A2 via VDR in an in vitro calcification model
